note: Grok Bot plugins/connectors referenced by this template. Not auto-configured in Pi; add equivalent MCP servers with `pi mcp add` or .pi/mcp.json.

plugins.name: AgentMail
plugins.description: Preferred. Research inboxes for newsletters, trials, and sales sequences. Create inboxes and read mail via the plugin MCP.

plugins.name: X
plugins.description: Needed for the X radar and complaint mining modules. Read-only: posts, mentions, replies for competitor and founder handles.

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Fallback only. Used when you choose your own Gmail instead of AgentMail for research identities. Puts newsletters and trials on your address.

plugins.name: Slack
plugins.description: Optional. Deliver the pulse to a channel you name instead of this chat.

plugins.name: Salesforce
plugins.description: Optional, churn module only. Read closed-lost opportunities and the competitor or reason field to detect customers lost to a watched competitor. Read only. A sheet or a paste works instead.

plugins.name: Google Sheets
plugins.description: Optional, churn module only. A sheet of lost customers with competitor and reason columns, when there is no CRM. Read only.
